symptom: `visible: [$currentObject/Status = Mod.Enum.Value]` stored as `… = 'Value'` (string) → MxBuild CE0117 "Error(s) in expression" (v0.13.0 regression; both engines)
cause: `conditionalExprToString` (added with #627) sent a qualified-enum `QualifiedNameExpr` to its `default` case → `xpathExprToString`, which converts a 3-part enum name to a string literal. Correct for an XPath *datasource* constraint (DB level), WRONG for a *client* visibility/editability expression (compares to the qualified enum value)
insight: Add an explicit `*ast.QualifiedNameExpr` case returning `e.QualifiedName.String()` (the qualified literal) before the `default`. Leaves the datasource `where` path (`buildXPathString`/`xpathExprToString`) untouched, so DB-level enums still stringify to `'Value'`. Applies to CREATE and ALTER (both use `conditionalExprToString`). Verify the datasource enum still stores `'Value'` and the visibility enum stays qualified; `mx check` = 0
